title: Preregistration in diverse contexts: a preregistration template for the application of cognitive models
description: Article (R. Soc. Open Sci. 8(10): 210155, 13 October 2021) arguing that preregistration, designed largely for simple experimental designs, needs adapting to cognitive modelling. It catalogues researcher degrees of freedom in model application (motivations and justifications, model parameterisations, parameter estimation, secondary data analysis, outliers and power analysis, robustness checks, well-documented code), presents a preregistration template for model application (Section 4.1, with sections on the cognitive model, the method of parameter estimation, robustness checks and sensitivity analyses, and contingency plans), and works through an example application with results, discussion, limitations and future directions.
